description: This Mendeley deposit publishes province-level cropland-mask archives for Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba in the Canadian Prairies. The article describes annual ten-metre classifications for 2017–2024, made with AlphaEarth satellite embeddings, Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada crop-inventory labels and a random-forest classifier. The current public version 2 lists three ZIP files, including an Alberta filename spelled “Alberata.zip”, and Mendeley states CC BY 4.0. The producer also describes a Google Earth Engine view that requires an account, but the Mendeley archives are a separate public access route. These classifications indicate likely persistent cropland, not measured irrigation or individual annual crop yield. Classification uncertainty, source-label errors and spatial transfer across heterogeneous Prairie landscapes limit parcel-scale interpretation. A reviewer-assessed use is defining crop-land exposure or agricultural service areas in water and food-supply simulations. data-sea-cropland10-southeast-asia-cropland-10m is a related cropland map in another region; no cross-product agreement was tested. No raster archive was downloaded.
